name: commit-msg-hook
description: Install commit-msg hook. Test that orphan feat: message exits 1 and feat: with Refs: passes.

exercise.cmd:
printf 'feat: orphan

No refs.
' > MSG && bash .git/hooks/commit-msg MSG; echo "orphan_exit=$?"; printf 'feat: ok

Refs: docs/features/001.md
' > MSG2 && bash .git/hooks/commit-msg MSG2; echo "ok_exit=$?"
